test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There are good points to each side and we need more ______ people that are willing to look at them from all angles.
solution:
The correct answer is "**unbiased**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Unbiased means ​'showing no prejudice for or against something; impartial, free from bias (किसी वस्तु के लिए या उसके खिलाफ कोई पूर्वाग्रह नही
